body: Open3D: A Modern Library for 3D Data Processing
plain_description: **Build software for working with 3D data using Open3D’s C++ and Python tools.** Process and visualize 3D data, reconstruct scenes, and align surfaces. GPU acceleration and support for PyTorch and TensorFlow are available.
technical_description: Open3D is an open-source C++ and Python library for 3D data processing. It provides data structures and algorithms for scene reconstruction, surface alignment, visualization, physically based rendering, and 3D machine learning with PyTorch and TensorFlow. Core 3D operations support GPU acceleration.
title: Open3D
